news.headline: Analysts Reiterate Buy Ratings, Raise Price Targets After Q2 Beat
news.summary: Following the Q2 print, Piper Sandler and Canaccord Genuity reiterated Buy ratings on Nektar, with price targets ranging from $153 to $185, citing the strengthened cash position and rezpegaldesleukin's Phase 3 momentum.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Stock Slides as Cash Burn Clouds Pipeline Progress
news.summary: Shares fell roughly 4% after management raised FY2026 guidance to $210-230 million in R&D spend and $60-65 million in G&A, stoking investor concern about the pace of cash burn even as the balance sheet strengthened.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Q2 revenue was $10.1 million with a net loss of $40.6 million (-$1.23/share, beating consensus of -$2.04); cash and investments reached $1.02 billion versus $245.8 million at year-end 2025, extending the runway into Q3 2028.

news.headline: Nektar Outlines REZPEG Phase 3 Timeline With Mid-2028 Data and 2029 BLA Plan
news.summary: On the Q2 call, management confirmed that following an End-of-Phase 2 meeting with the FDA it finalized the design of a single registrational Phase 3 trial in alopecia areata (start early 2027) and reiterated a first BLA submission for rezpegaldesleukin in 2029.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, two of three global registrational Phase 3 trials of rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis targeting about 1,530 patients total, with initial data expected mid-2028.

news.headline: Nektar Reports Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Nektar granted stock options on an aggregate of 36,000 shares to 23 newly hired employees at a $64.84 exercise price, reflecting continued headcount build-out to support the Phase 3 ZENITH AD program.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 trial start
catalysts.detail: Third pivotal Phase 3 trial (treatment-experienced atopic dermatitis patients) expected to begin enrollment, completing the ZENITH AD registrational program.

catalysts.label: EADV Congress data presentations
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to present longer-term REZOLVE-AD and REZOLVE-AA Phase 2b maintenance-period results for rezpegaldesleukin at the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology Congress.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly financial results and pipeline update; specific date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: Alopecia areata Phase 3 trial start
catalysts.detail: Single registrational Phase 3 study of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, designed after FDA End-of-Phase 2 meeting, planned to begin.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 readout
catalysts.detail: First topline data expected from the ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 pivotal atopic dermatitis trials.

catalysts.label: First BLA submission for rezpegaldesleukin
catalysts.detail: Company's stated target for filing the first Biologics License Application, pending positive Phase 3 atopic dermatitis data.

pulse: Nektar is now fully committed to advancing rezpegaldesleukin through Phase 3, having dosed the first ZENITH AD atopic-dermatitis patients in July and, following its August 13 Q2 print, finalized an FDA-aligned Phase 3 design for alopecia areata (start early 2027). The roughly $1.02 billion cash position funds operations into Q3 2028, past the mid-2028 ZENITH AD readouts, though raised R&D/G&A guidance triggered some post-earnings share weakness on cash-burn concerns even as sell-side analysts reiterated Buy ratings with targets of $153-$185. Watch for the ZENITH AD-3 trial start (~September 2026), EADV data presentations (October 1, 2026), and Q3 earnings for further timeline detail.
